spanish: que mandó Jehová a dar a ellos en día de ungir a ellos, de parte de hijos de Israel; estatuto de siempre a sus generaciones.

findings.issue: מָשְׁחוֹ is a qal infinitive construct with a 3ms suffix, and אֹתָם is the 3mp object. With both present, the suffix is the anointer. Spanish 'ungir a ellos' keeps the object and drops that masculine singular participant.
מֵאֵת is from + with (source). 'de parte de' can be read as representation on behalf of the sons of Israel.

notes: Relative, piel command, Jehová, qal dar, 3mp recipients, construct day, sons of Israel, statute of perpetuity, and their generations match the tokens.
